threads.body: [Build] This new mode task is not listed in `.github/scripts/instrumentations.sh` next to `gwt-2.0:javaagent:test`. Since `.github/scripts/metadata-ci-collect.sh` invokes only tasks from that list, the logs-mode run—and its `metadataConfig`—is omitted from telemetry metadata collection. Add `gwt-2.0:javaagent:testExceptionSignalLogs`, as is done for the other javaagent exception-signal tasks.

replies.body: i know i added the metadataConfig option, but I wasn't planning on collecting this data

threads.body: [Testing] Neither the default test nor `testExceptionSignalLogs` enables stable RPC semconv, so the advertised `error.type` behavior is never exercised. Add the RPC `testStableSemconv` and `testBothSemconv` tasks and make the span attributes mode-aware, asserting `error.type = java.io.IOException` for this failure in stable mode.

replies.body: i think migrating this whole module to handle stable semconv could be a followup
